<noinclude><div></noinclude>{{documentation/end box
| preload = {{{preload|}}}   <!--Allow custom preloads-->
| content = {{{content|}}}
| link box = {{{link box|}}}   <!--So "link box=off" works-->

| docpage = 
  {{#if: {{{1|}}}
  | {{{1|}}}
  | {{{docspace|{{NAMESPACE}}}}}:{{{template page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}/doc
  }}
| doc exist = 
  {{#ifexist: 
    {{#if: {{{1|}}}
    | {{{1|}}}   <!--Other docname fed-->
    | {{{docspace|{{NAMESPACE}}}}}:{{{template page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}/doc
    }}
  | yes
  }}
| docname fed =
  {{#if: {{{1|}}}
  | yes
  }}

| sandbox = 
  {{{docspace|{{NAMESPACE}}}}}:{{{template page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}/sandbox
| testcases = 
  {{{docspace|{{NAMESPACE}}}}}:{{{template page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}/testcases

| template page = 
  {{NAMESPACE}}:{{{template page|{{PAGENAME}}}}}

}}<noinclude>

<!-- Add categories and interwikis to the /doc subpage, not here! -->
</noinclude><noinclude>
